AdminSeo.noindexActive: The site is closed to indexing: search engines will not index it and the sitemap is empty. Turn the block off when you are ready to be found.
AdminSeo.iconHint: A single square image (PNG, JPEG or WEBP, at least 128 px, ideally 512): we derive 16, 32, 48, 180 (iOS), 192 and 512 px for the browser tab, shortcuts and manifest.
AdminSeo.socialHint: Shown in social and messaging previews (PNG, JPEG or WEBP, at least 600 px wide, 1200×630 recommended).
AdminSeo.textsIntro: They appear in search results and shares, in the visitor’s language (falling back to the default one).
AdminSeo.noDescription: No description: search engines will pick one from the content.
AdminSeo.noindex: Block indexing of the whole site
AdminSeo.noindexHint: Adds noindex to every page, closes robots.txt and empties the sitemap. Handy while testing; it does not remove what search engines already indexed.
AdminSeo.extraHint: For services that ask for a verification meta tag (name and content). Up to 10; tags managed by the site (robots, viewport, description…) are not allowed.
AdminSeo.sitemapIntro: Generated automatically: they only include public, indexable content (never drafts, private or excluded spaces), with translations as alternate languages. Submit them to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster.
AdminSeo.saveHint: Saves texts, verification and meta tags. Images upload immediately.
